honeymoon.title: Honeymoon inclusions
honeymoon.description: Honeymoon guests receive a surprise welcome gift, a small bottle of sparkling wine, a king bed, late checkout, and an upgrade to the next available room category, all subject to availability. A $35 spa credit applies to the specified Senses service for two. Enter "HONEYMOON" in the Special Service Request. Proof of marriage issued within 90 days is required at check-in.

hotel.note: All guests must wear an all-inclusive wristband. An environmental sanitation tax of MXN 83 per room per night is collected by the hotel and may change. Promotions and inclusions are subject to availability and restrictions.
